name: krp-core
description: KRP core: the geometry shared by Kaleidohedra, Rhombiverse and Polyhedraverse (by DICTO). Plain ES modules, no build step; three.js only for src/assembly.

scripts.verify: for s in packing pyrochlore quasicrystal rhombohedra shells roof-fold nets dicto-fcc kaleido; do node scripts/verify-$s.mjs || exit 1; done; for t in $(find src -name '*.test.mjs' | sort); do node $t > /dev/null || { echo FAIL $t; exit 1; }; done
